invariants: Clients alone remain paying/signed customers; tenants do not have login, price or billing access.
Only an authorized client's account policy or per-site override permits tenant contact topics. A client grant is not tenant COM-L SMS consent.
Customer identity comes from validated session, and edits require customerId plus serviceAddressId ownership.
Assigned STAFF see private location contact/access data only for their own active job, never unrelated sites.
Tenant repair token is single-use, time-bounded and scoped to this location's actively assigned physical machine; damage charges are never created.
Move-out leaves signed contracts/invoices unchanged; background erasure deletes former tenant PII without audit copies.
Import previews every CSV row and rejects duplicate, formula and cross-client data before atomic writes.
sequence: Add migration, retention and consent-scoped contact schema without rewriting existing rental relations.
Implement client/owner actions and UI with inaccessible foreign-site/guest authority.
Integrate assigned-visit DTO, one-time tenant maintenance with pending notice and no automatic SMS/billable repair.
Implement turnover task, global retention and validated transaction-safe CSV import, preserve no-PII audit.
Run focused unit/disposable database and real browser tests; full exact-head CI/review, track external acceptance separately.
acceptance: Client stays the paying and signing customer; tenant is a no-login no-prices location contact and account staff stay separate.
Every service address supports a unit label, protected access notes and current/past tenant/on-site contacts with preferred language and tenancy dates.

Client gives account-wide contact permission with per-location overrides for delivery/pickup, maintenance and swaps, who confirms appointments, and whether client receives a copy, all with attribution and timestamp.
Tenant SMS is denied absent independently recorded tenant COM-L consent; no real message before the existing activation gates.
Tenant repair reports create correctly scoped maintenance on the location machine and notify client; billable damage still requires independent client approval.
Client or owner can end tenancy and optionally request a machine-turnover check while rentals and invoices continue unchanged.
Exited tenant PII is erased after configurable retention default twelve months, leaving minimal non-identifying visit history.
Many-address import checks each row, previews errors and applies owner-authorized rows atomically after ownership and duplicate checks.

OWNER/ADMIN may edit all; assigned STAFF see contact/access detail only for their own visits; clients see/edit their own locations and cannot see another customer’s tenant via URL, action, search or export.
Real database, role/isolation, retention, import and browser positive/denied/recovery tests demonstrate full outcome with no production/provider effects.
